description: What a single present amount grows to at a fixed yearly rate with interest added to the balance at a chosen frequency, and the growth over the starting amount (FV = PV x (1 + r/n)^(n x t)). Use for questions about what a lump sum becomes after some years at an assumed rate, or the effect of compounding more often. Do not use for regular contributions (use smartfin_project_savings_growth), for what a real stock did (use smartfin_calculate_investment_return), or for a forecast: one fixed rate is an assumption. To find the starting amount, rate or time instead of the future value, use smartfin_calculate_missing_variable.

compounding_frequency.description: Times a year interest is added: 1 annually, 2 semiannually, 4 quarterly, 12 monthly, 52 weekly, 365 daily

currency.description: Currency symbol for the amounts in the summary only; amounts are never converted. The link opens the page in US dollars, and how_to says to pick the currency there. Default USD

present_value.description: Amount today in the currency chosen

years.description: Time in years; a part of a year is a decimal
